description_en: Restores a file from the recycle bin
description_zh: 恢复一个暂存回收站中的文件
name: CreateRecycleBinRestoreJob

parameters.help_en:
The file system ID. Required.

How to obtain:
Call DescribeFileSystems (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/nas/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describefilesystems) to query the file system list and obtain the FileSystemId.
Call CreateFileSystem (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/nas/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-createfilesystem) to create a file system and obtain the FileSystemId from the response.

Usage notes:
This operation applies only to General-purpose NAS file systems.
Before calling this operation, make sure that the recycle bin feature is enabled for the file system
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统 ID。必填参数。

获取方式：
调用 DescribeFileSystems (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/nas/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describefilesystems?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-27516.d_0) 查询文件系统列表获取 FileSystemId
调用 CreateFileSystem (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/nas/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-createfilesystem?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-27516.d_0) 创建文件系统后返回

使用说明：
本接口仅适用于通用型 NAS 文件系统
调用本接口前，需确保目标文件系统已开启回收站功能
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The FileId of the file or directory to restore.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412174.html operation to query the FileId of deleted data
parameters.help_zh:
待恢复的文件或目录的FileId。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412174.html接口查询已删除数据的FileId信息
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en:
The FileId of the directory to which the file is restored.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412173.html operation to query the TargetFileId of directories from which files have been deleted.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412163.html operation to query the TargetFileId of existing directories in the file system.

Special notes:
The FileId of the root directory of a file system is fixed to `2`. You can directly use this value as the TargetFileId to restore a file to the root directory without querying
parameters.help_zh:
文件恢复后所存储目录的 FileId。

您可以通过调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412173.html 接口查询执行过删除操作的目录 TargetFileId 信息。

您可以通过调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412163.html 接口查询文件系统中已存在目录 TargetFileId 信息。

特殊说明：
文件系统根目录的 FileId 固定为 `2`，可直接作为 TargetFileId 将文件恢复到根目录，无需查询即可使用
parameters.name: target_file_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

If you do not specify ClientToken, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若您未指定ClientToken，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
